description: This source file provides functions for parsing voice commands related to directions, place searches, and location questions. It includes utility functions for extracting coordinates, converting commands into structured requests, and generating simple answers for location-based queries.

methods.name: LatLng|None _maybe_latlng_from_text(text: str)
methods.description: Extracts latitude and longitude from a text string if present, returning a LatLng object or None.

methods.name: VoiceCommandAction parse_voice_command(text: str, user_location: LatLng | None)
methods.description: Parses a transcribed voice command into a structured VoiceCommandAction object based on command intent.

methods.name: PlaceSearchRequest build_place_search_request(action: VoiceCommandAction, user_location: LatLng | None)
methods.description: Converts a VoiceCommandAction of type 'search_places' into a PlaceSearchRequest object.

methods.name: DirectionsRequest build_directions_request(action: VoiceCommandAction, user_location: LatLng | None)
methods.description: Converts a VoiceCommandAction of type 'get_directions' into a DirectionsRequest object.

methods.name: str answer_location_qa(question: str, context: dict[str, Any] | None = None)
methods.description: Provides a conservative textual response to location-related questions.
